_comment: Post-setup provisioning, applied by the tweaks phase (skip with -SkipTweaks; honors -WhatIf). Toggles are best-effort and idempotent. NOTE: on Windows 11 the taskbar pin and default-browser association are most reliable when applied during imaging/OOBE (they affect new user profiles); see docs/provisioning.md. Steam and other baseline apps live in config/apps.json (match.always).
